articles.summary: HANGZHOU, China, Jan. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ: NTES and HKEX: 9999, " NetEase " or the "Company"), a leading internet and game services provider, today announced that it will report financial results for the fourth quarter and fiscal year 2025 on Wednesday, February 11, 2026,
articles.title: NetEase to Report Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2025 Financial Results on February 11
